name: На вираже
summary: The action of the action-packed film takes place around an auto track. The story begins with the murder of the director of the racing team "Favorite" Fedor Golovin, who is the leader of the last competitions. This death means the death of the team - without serious financial support, its continued existence is questionable. The murder was organized by a criminal structure, which, controlling the results of car racing, controls the sweepstakes at the stadium next to the car track. Due to the circumstances, the administrator of the "Favorite" Konstantin Chizhov refuses to put up with the collapse and decides to do everything to revive the team and try to win the final race of the season.

name: The Three GentleBros
summary:
The Three Gentlebros depicts a chaotic relationship between a strict and controlling mother and her three sons. Pimpattra, an overbearing mother plans to set up her three sons with the women she believes to be wife materials. But things are not going as Pimpattra has planned when three women who are far from her ideal daughter-in-law come into her sons' lives. Will these non-wifey types be able to win over this domineering mother? 

Pimpattra is a socialite who is successful in everything except her love life. She has been in many relationships. She has three sons who were born from different fathers. Itchaya, her oldest son, is a multiracial young businessman. Mom Luang Tewit or Thames, her second son, is an heir of a noble family which owns a well-known mall. Ashira, her youngest son, is a good-looking college student. Pimpattra is planning to find perfect wives for her sons to make up for her negligence while they were growing up. However, her sons don't seem to be happy about her plan. Her goal is also hindered by women in her sons' lives. Kaewklaw is a self-supporting woman whom Itchara is interested in. Nuengnaret is a sassy woman who is working with Thames but she is Pimpattra's foe. View Nareeya is a tough young woman whom Ashira hires to obstruct his mother's plan. What will be the endings of the three brothers' romance? How will their relationship with their mother wrap up?

name: UMG
summary:
In UMG: Unidentified Mysterious Girlfriend a childhood girlfriend returns after being missing for 8 years, and there is something different about her. 
Mew, a boy who aspires to be an astronaut, finds his first love in Erng, his best friend. Erng, like Mew, is an odd girl with no other friends. They are always joined at the hip and do everything together, even establishing their own ‘secret base' in the woods. However, their childhood fun comes to an abrupt end when Erng vanishes without a trace.
Eight years later, Mew is now a university student. He, still overcome with guilt, blames himself for Erng's disappearance. He has no social life because he is waiting for Erng to return. Jack, his childhood bully, is his only friend. One day, because of the faculty advisor, Mr. Kit, Mew and Jack join the "Mystery Exploration Club". Here, Mew meets new friends like O, a senior whose hobby is hunting monsters, and Fahsai, a beautiful girl who believes in the existence of extraterrestrial life. Mew begins to open up to new friends and the possibility of new love in this bizarre club... when, despite having been missing for 8 years, Erng suddenly reappears!
The return of Erng is riddled with mysteries. Although she remembers Mew, she has no recollection of her disappearance. She also appears to have superhuman abilities. Oddities continue as 42, a mysterious alien creature, arrives in search of Erng! It's time for the Mystery Exploration Club members to band together and discover the truth. Is Erng, who reappears, the same person as Mew's first love, who vanished 8 years ago? Find out in UMG: Unidentified Mysterious Girlfriend.

name: Star In My Mind
summary:
Star in My Mind portrays a romantic story of a secret admirer who spends his life by the quote "No matter which direction the earth rotates, the North Star will always shine at the same spot." Time passes, people come and go, but his love will be with the very same person, always. 

Daonueaonce again whirls up to meet with Khabkluen, his "first love," and the classmate he confessed to before traveling to study in Germany. However, "Have a safe flight" was the only thing he got in return for the tough confession he finally had the courage to make. Even so, this reunion makes "Daonuea" realize that no matter how much time passes, the North Star will always remain where it is.

Root for this secret admirer whose mind can never be changed by the amount of time or people who enter his life. He, comparable to the North Star which always remains at the same spot, is waiting for someone to open up his heart...and let the star lead the way.

name: Home School
summary: Home School is a boarding school in the middle of a remote forest. Every three years, the school selects new students who meet their criteria, each generation comprising no more than thirteen students. The students spend a total of three years at the school. The school's meant to appeal to wealthy students with its unique curriculum and all the comforts of home. However, Home School seems more like a prison than a school with its strict rules and stark isolation.

name: Cupid's Last Wish
summary: When a will is a cause of conflict and becomes Cupid's Last Wish, a young man whose soul gets swapped with his sister after an accident must set off a journey to get holy water from 4 temples within 7 days in order to swap back to his body. His companion to this quest is his former best friend, who is now his foe. A twist of fate has somehow tightened and mended their relationship while searching for the holy water across the country. Apart from the quest, he needs to protect his farm from the two evil relatives who wish to take all the assets of his family. Find out how the story unfolds and see if the journey can forever change their relationship. Why does the will that creates a conflict is called a Cupid's wish?

name: Oops! Mr.Superstar Hit on Me
summary: Thailand's top superstar, nicknamed "The Breath of Asia", Ton Nareubet accidentally shares a meaningful bonding night with Cake, a college student intern 20 years his junior. He mistakes her for a callgirl his best friend sends over, when in fact, Cake is just there to ask for his autograph for her mother Kanda who is a big fan. After the fateful night, Ton tries to get in touch with Cake to take responsibility by asking his nephew and manager Nadol to contact her. But believing Cake is just a social climber looking for an easy life by sleeping with celebrity, Nadol never reaches out. Things escalate when Cake's best friend, Now, out of anger on her friend's behalf, posts on her social media about a celebrity with the initial "T.N." who knocks a girl up and bails. The media is quick to pick up on the story and the whole thing turns into a big scandal. Now Ton rushes to get in touch with Cake, wanting to start over as a couple. How will this relationship with obstacles more than just age difference turn out?

name: My Dear Donovan
summary:
My Dear Donovan will make your heart flutter with the story of a model who flies all his way to Thailand in search of his ex-lover. Unfortunately, the cupid's arrow makes him fall in love with a kind-hearted manager. 

Donovan, a hot American model from Palee Modeling, is in fact, in search of Maria who has come to Thailand and lost touch with him. Pam, a kindergarten teacher who is living her simple life, has been raised by her grandparents after her mother Parichat has left her to start a new life in the USA. Parichat comes back to Thailand with her new husband and her son, which makes Grandfather Poon  so angry that it triggers his heart disease. He needs to undergo an expensive operation. For this reason, Pam has to work at Parichat's company, Palee Modeling, to earn money. She is assigned to work as a manager and a personal interpreter of Donovan, a hot model. Many girls have been trying to get his attention, including Jessica, a mixed-race model, and Dararai, a high-class old maid celebrity. Thus, Pam has to manage Donovan's life, both his work and his personal matters. As their relationship is growing fast, this love gets obstructed when Pam finds out the secret of Donovan. Will the love between Pam and Donovan get fulfilled in the end?

name: The Warp Effect
summary:
Alex breaks the oath he made to his mother forbidding him from losing his virginity before turning eighteen, causing chaos he never could've anticipated. 

Seventeen-year-old Alex lacks self-confidence and his one passion in life is photography. His household is all male, his mother having died in an accident. Before she passed, she made him promise to hold onto his virginity until the right time. However, it's nearly unbearable; his closest friends See-ew and Nim have already given up theirs, leaving only him. He, therefore, aims to lose it at Jedi's house party. 

School activist Jean goes to the party and it seems as though he'll lose his virginity to her. The evening turns to chaos, though, and Alex wakes up with no memory of what happened. He's aged into a man of twenty-seven: a gynecologist and sex expert. He must solve the mystery of that night and all the mess that followed using a polaroid of that night. Will he be able to return to the past?

name: The Eclipse
summary:
The Eclipse tells the story of the rule keeper who feels shaken by the rule breaker.

Everything happens inside the walls of Suppalo School, the country's leading all-boys secondary school with highly strict discipline. There is even a rumor that students who break school regulations will be cursed and the curse gets more severe as a solar eclipse approaches...
When there are rules, there are rule breakers. A group of students calling themselves "The World Remembers" unite with the idea that they will not follow obsolete school regulations and protest for their rights and justice. Akk, the student head prefect and the school's ideal kid, along with his fellow prefects Kanlong and Wasuwat, must constantly deal with these protesters. Then there is Ayan, a new student who seems to carry secrets with him everywhere he goes and regularly challenges the school norms. Akk, no doubt, needs to keep an eye on him. Ayan enrolls at this institution in the hopes of discovering why his uncle Dika committed suicide. His uncle's old journal, which claims the reason for his death was someone from this school, is the only evidence he has. Ayanis aware that he is being watched by Akk and always annoys him back. The two of them become close without realizing it. After spending a lot of time together, Akk develops a secret crush on Ayan but he keeps denying his feelings for this new student. However, when Ayan becomes especially close to Thuaphu, the school's top student, Akk gets jealous. Akk's crush on Ayan combines with curiosity. He notices Ayan has an old journal that he refuses to let anyone touch. Akkattempts to take the notebook in order to discover whyAyanhas joined his school and reports it to Chadok, the headmaster who instructs him to keep a close watch on Ayan. Despite the fact that all of the teachers are dissatisfied with their wayward kids, there is Sani, a visionary teacher who assists her students only from afar because she does not have enough power at school. Time passes. The students begin to doubt the curse and investigate who is causing the chaos in order to scare them away from breaching the rules. Every day, the protest becomes more intense. How will the relationship between Akk and Ayan play out? What is the truth behind the curse?

name: Good Old Days
summary: In an antique shop, the value of each item is the story behind them. People who sell their belongings here can reminisce on their lives, and buyers see their value hidden within. Six stories about memories, love, dreams and separation are linked to six items.

name: Ок, Аліна
summary: Alina Sheremeta's show features provocative themes, various formats, selected jokes and top-class irony.  These are reports, discussions, travel blogs, and explainers. It's better than Wikipedia and Google.

previousepisode.name: Про хейт, любов та вдячність 一 останній випуск «Ок, Аліни» / #ОкАліна №19

name: Never Let Me Go
summary: Never Let Me Go follows an intense story about love that blossoms in the middle of a power struggle.  Nuengdiao and his mother, Tanya, are in great danger after his father was shot to death. Palm is suddenly selected to be Nuengdiao's bodyguard. When his duty and heart are in conflict, what will Palm choose to do? How deep will the relationship between these two young men grow?

name: 10 Years Ticket
summary: 10 Years Ticket tells a story of Phukao who loses his good brother at the hands of a sister he once loved with his whole heart. Phukao grows up in a family who used to own an open air cinema business. He loses his wonderful older brother forever at the hands of the sister of Kongkwan on the night of 14 February 2013, the last day of airing and his family's beloved business. That day should have been one of their fond memories to look back on. Unfortunately, it has taken an unforgettable turn and left a scar on their hearts until today. The truth is Phukao's and Kongkwan's families used to love each other like siblings, neighbors, and friends. Also, young Kongkwan is like Phukao's first love. That loss completely tears Phukao's family apart. His parents go their separate ways, while his family's financial situation becomes increasingly worse. Even though Phukao grows into a handsome, talented man who is loved and admired by everyone for his generosity, his kindness is never extended to Kongkwan and her family. Phukao hates them with all his heart. No matter how many times they move houses to escape from him, Phukao always finds and harasses them. He makes sure that Kongkwan's family remembers and never forgets that they have ruined his family and his brother's life. In 2022, Phukao and Kongkwan can no longer run from each other. Kongkwan fights her way to get into the best high school in the city, which happens to be where Phukao is studying and full of memories of their brother and sister. In this reunion, neither Phukao nor Kongkwan is willing to give in to the other. Each of them is ready to fight for their own family and older sibling. Once childhood sweethearts and now enemies, will they find their way back into love?

name: Midnight Motel
summary: Midnight Motel reveals the stories about teens who are making money to build up their future…but end up making trouble. The teens eagerly team up to unfold the story of night people who want to pay off their debts. They create a secret application for booking sideline girls but then accidentally get involved in a mysterious death of a businessman, the app's client, who spends a night at the hotel offering the service.

name: Moonlight Chicken
summary: Moonlight Chicken follows Jim and Wen who are ready to reveal their recipe of love and dish of happiness, Steamed Chicken with Rice, that will make your heart full.  It tells the story of love and complicated relationships in different flavors of moods waiting to be touched and tasted.

name: Dirty Laundry
summary: In Dirty Laundry, Neon, a lonely late-shift laundromat attendant, meets Night, a murder mystery novelist who saves her from the rampage of other customers and sweeps her off her feet. Neon falls in love with Night overnight, which brings her to his apartment where she discovers a briefcase containing one million baht. Overcome by greed, she takes the briefcase home with her and hides it at the laundromat. After Night finds out, he comes to reclaim the briefcase from Neon who gladly gives it back only to find that the briefcase is missing. The only way to identify the thief is through the log of customers who came to the laundromat. The suspects include Judo, a good-looking college student; Chompoo, Night's apartment caretaker; Momay, a sexy karaoke girl; and Nick and Smile, a rock couple. All have suspicious behavior. Who is the real culprit and how will the love story between Night and Neon turn out?

name: Vice Versa
summary:
Vice Versa follows the adventures of Talay and Puen, who encounter bizarre scenarios. They find themselves in the bodies of strangers in a parallel universe. The only way to put a stop to this chaos is to discover the secret key that will take them back to where they came from.

Talay wakes up in the body of a man named Tess. He meets Puen, a famous actor who is now in the body of Tun after an accident. Both of them have to live their lives in a new universe that is not their home, and they might even be each other's "portkeys" which can help them to return to where they came from once they have completed what they hope to achieve. The two have Phuwadol , a male nurse who helps people from the same universe they left behind, to guide them through life in this new universe. Tun and Talay have a mission to fulfill, and they are assisted by their pals Kita, Fuse, and Friend Credits members Up and Aou. Love and friendship grow with them in the new universe. What will happen with their mission? Will they be able to get back to their home universe? Stay tuned and find out together.

name: P.S. I Hate You
summary:
P.S. I Hate You is adapted from a popular novel named ‘Wongkot Dokmai' (the flower maze) by Baison. It depicts the story of love, jealousy, and viciousness of a girl friend circle and their hidden secrets. 

A secret tapeof Pantiwa is exposed at the wedding of hers and Pureenut. After the incident, she decides to commit suicide. Meena is trying to find the culprit who switched the wedding presentation video with her friend's sex tape. During her investigation, Meena needs to dig through the history with her ex-boyfriend, Pitch, and also discovers hidden secrets of her friends. Tidawan is having an affair with Chanon, Meena's boyfriend. Metacha is secretly filmed and blackmailed by Korawee who is the new boyfriend of Tarinee – Metacha's mother. Sarasawadee who seems to be a sweet conservative woman, is a mistress of Captain Key. She is being closely monitored by Nuttamon, Key's wife, and Lieutenant Term, Nattamon's cousin. Palana, a mysterious girl in this friend circle, may hold some secrets.

It is said that living with one thousand poisonous snakes is not as scary as having untrustworthy friends. Don't forget to tune into this drama and find out how these tangled relationships unfold.

name: My School President
summary:
Tinn is a perfect 12th-grade student body president who is gorgeous, intellectual, athletic, has a mother who works as the school principal, and is everyone's favorite. Tinn has a dream. He wants "to be with someone before finishing high school. "It might sound simple for everyone else but, for Tinn, "this is nearly mission impossible!!"
The first obstacle is that Tinn's crush is Gun, the head of the music club and the main singer of the "Chinzilla" band, which has a strict rule that says "band members are not allowed to date until the Hot Wave Music Contest is over. "Gun's band members include drummer Pat, keyboardist Por, bassist Win, and sucky guitarist Yo. They aren't even skilled enough to perform in front of a broad audience, let alone compete in the Hot Wave Music Contest.
The second obstacle is that this institution is highly academic. The school principal, Tinn's mother, instructs Tinn to get rid of all clubs that do not bring glory to the school, among which the music club is number one on the list. Tinn is hence Gun's "number one enemy." Meanwhile, Tinn will go to any length to keep his mother from discovering that her noble son has a crush on the head of the music club.
The third obstacle is that the new guitarist at the music club Sound is incredibly skilled and attractive. He gets along great with Gun since they share a musical language. How can a love-inexperienced nerd like Tinn, who has Gun as his first love, compete with that?
Though it's tough, there's nothing Tinn can't do. A year from now, he will do anything in his power as student body president to help Gun win the Hot Wave Music Contest, hoping that Gun will appreciate his effort and finally proclaim, "...My boyfriend is the school president..."

name: Devil Sister
summary: Irin, the it girl running Bannasorn Publishing House, is crowned "the devil" for her tempestuous and fearless demeanor. But what nobody knows is that it is all an act. The truth is Irin only puts up a mean front just so her 7-year-younger little sister, Inn, could stand out more and be adored by all. But no matter how well Irin puts on such a cattish act, she can never stop her younger next-door neighbor Namchafrom falling in love with her. In fact, Irin and Namcha used to date when they were students, but for some reason, Irin broke things off without an explanation and devastated Namcha in the process. Namcha is now a veterinarian working in a hospital, and since he's never forgotten his first love, he's ready to do whatever it takes this time around to get back together with the love of his life. Since Irin won't believe he is still in love with her, Namcha makes it his mission to prove her wrong. Unfortunately for them, this second chance at love is somehow full of obstacles because Inn has also been in love with Namcha for a long time and is working with none other than their family's lawyer Jinto sabotage her sister's relationship. Jin himself, through some elaborate schemes, is working to gain the trust of both Irin and her grandfather to take care of the family. And then comes Ploychan, the owner of a dog farm who's helping Namcha and his hospital with an ulterior motive by using her dog, Action, as a go-between man. Love should come easy for the two of them, but family, work, and even friends all seem to tear them apart. How will this love be for Irin and Namcha?

name: Be My Favorite
summary:
Kawi, a 30-year-old young man who lives a poor life in a narrow rented room, works on subtitles every day, has no savings, no dreams, no inspiration, and most importantly, no significant other. He was one of those in his prime who had completely failed in his life, while Pearmai, who is his first love and one-sided love for over 10 years, has a happy life. She is about to marry Pisaeng, a classmate who is handsome and good-looking and was a member of the same faculty during their time in college.

Kawi discovers that the musical crystal ball, an important gift he had intended to buy for Pearmai in his freshman year, has taken him back in time to his 18-year-old life, where he attempts to mend his relationship with Pearmai. With Pisaeng always hanging around, waiting to be a roadblock, everything turned upside down. Instead of being fulfilled with Pear, instead, he fell for Pisaeng.

name: Astrophile
summary:
Kimhanmeets his college senior Nubdao again unexpectedly, but he's the only one who can remember their history. Their new relationship develops later when he starts buying every product from a home shopping show she hosts and pretends to constantly find issues with those products to get close to her. Kimhanlives the other side of his life as an artist. Afraid to reveal himself, he goes by the name Klang Mesa (Midsummer). Pete takes advantage by posing as Klang Mesa. Nubdao's best friend Nammon  is a big fan of Klang Mesa. When Nammondiscovers that Peteis Klang Mesa, she falls in love with him without having any idea that he is a fake.

Soon after, Min-jun, host and owner of the show Nubdao hosts, orders her character to be more bold, sassy, and sexy. Although this doesn't please Tankoon, the show's producer and Nubdao's close friend, no one cango against Min-jun's wishes. All Tankoon can do is look after and support Nubdao from afar. Meanwhile, Kimhanalso wants to cheer Nubdaoup. He disguises himself as "loong nhuad", a mystery guy who gives her advice and keeps her company via text messages. How will their relationships unfold? Stay tuned to find out!

name: Hooligan
summary: An 18-year-old soccer player who suffers a serious knee injury must give up his dream of becoming a professional player. Instead, Mads finds new meaning in forming relationships with football fans, now fighting for his club off the field.

previousepisode.name: Den, der lever stille, lever godt

name: K3, een nieuw begin
summary: K3, een nieuw begin follows Hanne, Marthe and the brand new K3 during the first weeks after the competition and is also part of the first series of major shows in the Sportpaleis. The series also takes a unique look behind the scenes at the release of the new single, the clip recordings and the preparations for the new album.

name: Heartbeat Broadcasting Accident
summary: An office drama in the fantasy genre in which Yun And So, a young girl of about twenty, starts working on an online trading platform. She will face challenges in both work and love as she finds herself in the middle of a love struggle between her first love Cha Sung Woo and her longtime friend Kwon Hyuk.

name: To Fly with You
summary:
Shen Zhengyi, a girl who has loved skating all her life, found her goal after participating in winter sports competitions. Behind her mother's back, she decides to try to enter the Zhu Feng Sports Club to become a professional short track speed skater. Due to the lack of professional training, she faces serious problems, but she still manages to get into the team.
With the support of Shao Beisheng from the figure skating team, she overcomes all obstacles and wins the trust of her comrades, becoming the black horse of the competition season.

name: Please Be Married
summary:
Ye Xiange is a trainee at Linshan Entertainment. Before she officially debuted, she got into a big scandal planned by her own good friend, and her company decided to terminate the contract. While unemployed, Ye Senge met the heartless CEO of Su Group, Su Men, to do an internship at his company.
Then an incredible thing happened: a five-year-old boy Su Zian came to Ye Xiang and said that he was her son from the future, and his father was Su Mucheng. Ye Xiang Ge was shocked. Su Mu Chen found out about it, and he had no choice but to live with them.

Based on Manhua "I'm coming! Mom, where's my dad?"

name: Rydderevolusjonen
summary: Desta Marie Beeder and her team of experts help participants who live in constant chaos and clutter get rid of half of their belongings.

name: Iribito: Iribito
summary: Takamura Naho is an avid art collector and deputy director of Ariyoshi Art Museum, which she inherited from her grandfather. Her husband, Kazuki, is the third generation owner of Takamura Gallery, a famous gallery located in Ginza. Although Kazuki loves his wife, he is jealous of Naho who has a keen eye for arts which he doesn't have no matter how hard he tries. One day, Naho encountered a painting during her stay in Kyoto. The artist left her name "Aoba" and is an unknown painter called Shirane Itsuki who could not speak. Naho later learned from Itsuki that she is the disciple and adopted daughter of famous painter Shimura Teruyama and she has been deprived of her freedom by him for the past 17 years. While following Itsuki's arts, Naho accidentally encounters a fate-changing truth.

name: Mute
summary: Han Na is a female concert organizer who has an incredible secret ability: when she encounters a person whom she loves, she can "hear" their thoughts. While trying to snare a prestigious full-time job, she has a chance encounter with a man named Je Won, who has trouble expressing his feelings and suffers from a hearing-related problem. When they meet, Han Na discovers that she can read his mind, and when they are together, Je Won's hearing problems magically disappear. A romantic bond slowly develops between them. However, after they kiss for the first time, Han Na discovers that she can no longer read Je Won's mind. Will love continue to bloom for Han Na even after she stops "hearing" his innermost thoughts?

name: Candified: Home for the Holidays
summary: The challenge - create a life-size house made of ...CANDY! Watch as Candy Queen Jackie Sorkin and her team of candy artists design, glue, melt and shape hundreds of thousands of sweet pieces to build a fantasy come to life….just in time for the holidays.

name: Covenant
summary: Covenant is a one-hour anthology series that transforms the stories and characters of the Bible that we know so well into a suspenseful drama - sometimes thriller - fueled by the truth of God's Word.

name: Jeopardy! National College Championship
summary: Jeopardy! National College Championship is a multiconsecutive-night event that features 36 students from 36 colleges and universities from across the country, battling head-to-head for nine days of intense competition.

name: Positive Energy
summary: Finding new sources of energy is a worldwide challenge. Modern societies are accustomed to citizens turning on lights at the flick of a switch, gassing up fast cars, and cheaply flying from city to city, but how will continued energy needs be met without damaging the planet? This series finds former "Mythbusters" host Kari Byron and British TV personality Dallas Campbell presenting innovators around the world who are creating new ways to power the future. Revealed are visionary large- and small-scale projects aimed at finding clean, renewable, affordable energy, and the hosts even help create a new energy installation.

name: Guy's Grocery Games: Guy Cooks the Games
summary: Guy Fieri and his son Hunter decide to take a trip down memory lane and watch one of their favorite GGG episodes: All-Star Vegetarian Games. Hunter surprises his dad by challenging him to cook along with the challenges featured in the show. Guy gets a taste of what he puts chefs through as Hunter makes sure his dad follows all the challenge rules and sticks to the 30-minute clock. GGG judge Justin Warner joins Guy to assess his dishes, compare them to the dishes in the episode and decide if Guy is able to keep up with his own challenges.

name: Shield of Tomorrow
summary: The Federation is on the brink of war with the Dominion. In the shadow of this cold war, the crew members of the USS Sally Ride must work together to not only protect the Federation, but protect it's soul as well. An epic story from the Star Trek universe that you know and love.

previousepisode.name: "... and know the place for the first time."

name: Party A Who Lives Beside Me
summary: Trainee designer Ye Xuan dreams of working in an advertising agency, but she has not been transferred to a permanent contract for six months, and all she gets is a lot of small, featureless orders. Finally, an interesting advertising project appears, and Ye Xuan takes it up with enthusiasm to demonstrate his professional level. However, there is still a certain "side A" - its competitor. To cope with stress at work, the girl is helped by a strange neighbor Li Jinan, with whom Ye Xuan is having an affair. Who would have thought that he is the dark "side of A".

name: Part-Time Melo
summary: A part-time chemistry romance that takes place at a restaurant with the worst chemistry of people; a girl who's never dated before but wants to flirt, a spy guy who has to stop the flirting, a girl of natural science that lives on data, a man of liberal arts who lives on emotions and others.

name: The Memory About You
summary:
Shen Hou and Yan Xiaochen fell in love with each other at first sight. But life presents them with unpleasant surprises.
Due to the death of her father and the difficulties that have arisen in the family, Xiaochen is forced to work part-time in a bar to pay for her studies at the university. One day she meets Cheng Zhiyuan, a handsome rich guy who is courting a girl, causing Shen Hou's jealousy.
The lovers' wedding is canceled due to suddenly revealed family circumstances. Yan Xiaochen finds herself in a difficult situation and becomes heavily dependent on Cheng Zhiyuan, who warmly cares for his girlfriend. However, Shen Hou reappears in their lives, who reveals the innermost secret of Zhiyuan.
Based on the novel of the same name by Tonghua.

name: Heartbeat Love
summary:
A brilliant physicist with a cold, closed character and a comic book heroine with a typical Mary Sue storyline fall in love with each other.
Based on Manhua GoNi ""Xin Tian Lian Ai She".

name: Luxury Christmas for Less
summary: All the inside information, tips and tricks for how to bag a top quality Christmas without breaking the bank

name: Spirou & Fantasio
summary: The adventures of the intrepid Spirou, accompanied by his reporter friend Fantasio and his squirrel Spip.

name: Insânia
summary: A personal tragedy causes young forensics investigator Paula to have a breakdown, which results in her admittance to a psychiatric hospital. There, she is pulled into the darkest and most terrifying corners of her mind by a mysterious doctor.

name: Largados e Pelados Brasil
summary: For 21 days, men and women - who meet naked in front of the cameras - will form pairs and will be challenged to survive in one of the most inhospitable environments in the world. No food, water or clothing. After the success of the first season of Largados e Pelados Brasil, a new group of Brazilians will have the chance to explore an extremely challenging region! They will have to overcome physical and mental challenges that increase day by day.

name: The Curse
summary: The Curse is a comedy caper set in London in the early 80's, following a gang of hopeless small time crooks who through their own stupidity and poor judgement find themselves embroiled in one of the biggest gold heists in history.

name: Diana Boss
summary: Lawyer by day, rapper by night. In a world ruled by men, whether rappers or lawyers, Malika goes through battles, at the office or on the radio, and traces her path as a free woman with her best weapons: her words.

name: Let the World See
summary: Let the World See is a fresh and deep examination of Ms. Mamie Till-Mobley's fight to bring her son's body home to Chicago and her pivotal yet heartbreaking decision to have an open-casket funeral for the public to see, which ultimately served as a turning point for the civil rights movement. The docuseries also traces Ms. Mamie Till-Mobley's journey back to the Jim Crow South to face her son's murderers in court. The program will illustrate how the Till family has continued her legacy since her death in 2003, remaining active in the movement as the deaths of Trayvon Martin, George Floyd, Ms. Breonna Taylor and others sparked protests around the country.

name: Supernatural Academy
summary: Separated at birth and growing up in diametrically opposite environments, twin wolfshifters are reunited at the Supernatural Academy and learn that they are dragon-marked. Cursed to serve the evil Dragon King, these adversarial sisters must learn to get over their differences and trust each other to save themselves and the world.

name: March
summary: March celebrates the colorful, boisterous and competitive world of HBCU band culture through the eyes of the experts - the band members and leaders themselves. Embedded inside the Prairie View A&M University Marching Band, The Marching Storm, this engaging eight-part series will capture the blood, sweat, and tears each member sheds to make it to the field while balancing their dynamic college life.

name: Farmhouse Facelift
summary: Siblings Billy Pearson, a craftsman contractor, and Carolyn Wilbrink, a designer, tackle the toughest farmhouse renovations for their clients, bringing stunning designs and customized modern conveniences to each new project.

name: Money Heist: Korea - Joint Economic Area
summary: Thieves overtake the mint of a unified Korea. With hostages trapped inside, the police must stop them — as well as the shadowy mastermind behind it all.

name: Britain's Deadliest Mums & Dads
summary: An investigation into the stories of some of Britain's most infamous parents.

previousepisode.name: The Killer In My Home: A Deadliest Mums & Dads Special

name: The Toys That Built America: Snack Sized
summary: The Toys That Built America: Snack Sized is the high-speed, half-hour series that serves up the stories of the toys that shaped our history. Starting in the modern-day, then taking viewers back to the beginning, each episode focuses on the innovators, surprising facts, and cultural phenomena behind a specific iconic brand. This is everything you never knew about all the toys you know and love.

name: Trouble Street Maker
summary: Set in 2020, which follows the life on a 17 years old boy Dc Themmie known as The main character in the first episode, who is Themmie. It makes Lizzy and Goldex mad at him for his distruction of the city.

name: The Best of All the Smoke with Matt Barnes and Stephen Jackson
summary: The hit podcast ALL THE SMOKE WITH MATT BARNES AND STEPHEN JACKSON features raw and unfiltered conversations on the game with two NBA Champions. These "Best of" episodes each cover a burning theme spanning over 40 interviews featuring career reflections, on-court battles and candid personal stories from some of the biggest icons in sports and entertainment including the late Kobe Bryant, Dwyane Wade, Snoop Dogg, Jamie Foxx, Allen Iverson and more.

name: Summer Again
summary: Tong Xi, a ballet dancer, is forced to return from the big city to her hometown due to her mother's job transfer. She wants to hide her tough girl character by transferring to another school, but is seen through by her childhood friend, Lin Nan Yi, who knows her roots and can't get along with her. Tong Xi is acting while Li Nan Yi is trying to blow her cover. From frequent misunderstandings to mutual help, the couples gradually develop a tacit understanding and reliance on each other in their daily life with a group of small-town students. However, Tong Xi learns that Lin Nan Yi is the comic god she has admired for a long time. When the confusion in the process of finding the dreams hits the young and ignorant girl's feelings

name: Finding Magic Mike
summary: Ten regular guys who have "lost their magic" are put through the paces of a Magic Mike Live bootcamp, baring their souls - and more - as they learn to perform sexy and daring dance routines with one being crowned the real Magic Mike. The winner will pocket a cash prize.

name: The King of Tears, Lee Bang Won
summary: The King of Tears, Lee Bang Won sheds new light on leader Lee Bang Won who took the initiative to establish the Empire of Joseon during the end of the Goryeo Dynasty and early Joseon Dynasty when the ancient order of Goryeo was destroyed and the new order of Joseon was created.

name: Love Twist
summary: A family's love and life are completely twisted because of lies.

name: The Weakest Link
summary: Romesh Ranganathan takes charge of the back-stabbing big money game show. Can the contestants create a chain of answers and avoid the boot?

name: И в счастье и в беде
Я заберу твою семью
summary: Elena devoted all her time to the family, but neither her husband nor mother appreciated her efforts. And when her younger sister, released from prison, appears in her life, it became even worse. Since childhood, spoiled, not adapted to life and dodgy, Rita decides to finally "poison" Elena's life, in every possible way setting her children against her. This turns into another tragedy and aggravates relationships in the family circle so much that the woman decides to commit suicide. It was at this moment that a stranger named Mikhail rescued her and offered a deal - to get a job at the firm of his longtime business rival. Elena agrees, not even knowing how this work will turn out for her.

name: Deadly Affairs: Betrayed by Love
summary: A Michigan couple starts up a comic book store, but when business heats up, they hire someone whose presence changes their marriage forever; a ten-year marriage falls apart when a bored wife pursues an old friend, with deadly consequences.

name: Holmes Family Rescue
summary: Mike Holmes has been making it right for years, and now it's a family affair. Mike's daughter Sherry and son Michael share their own dedication and expertise as they join forces to rescue homeowners from botched construction jobs and renovation fatigue.

name: Ice Vikings
summary: Ice Vikings takes viewers inside a world never before seen on television: Lake Winnipeg's commercial ice fishing industry, where descendants of Icelandic Vikings race against time and weather to bring their catch to shore before the ice gives way. These unique, brave women and men face blizzards, cracking ice and danger from every side as they use traditional ice fishing methods learned from their ancestors: Icelandic Vikings who settled near Lake Winnipeg more than 150 years ago. Ice fishing is one of the most dangerous professions in the world, in one of the most unpredictable work environments on the planet: Lake Winnipeg. With big money at stake (commercial fishing is a $25 million a year industry in Manitoba), and more than 700 people each year setting out on the ice every winter, these ice vikings put their life on the line for every fish and paycheck.

name: The Third Man
summary: Harry Lime is the owner/operator of Harry Lime, Inc., an international import/export organization with offices in New York City and London. Harry has an assistant, the no-nonsense, numbers-crunching accountant/associate Bradford Webster. Harry is a ladies' man, a world traveler, and a world-renowned businessman -- even though his criminal past occasionally haunts him. In contrast, Brad is strictly business: he can rattle off the projected profit of a business deal in terms of both American dollars and British pounds without the aid of an adding machine, and occasionally appears to have a negative attitude toward Harry's romantic encounters with women from around the world.

name: Le petit rapporteur
summary: Satirical French television show, mixing humor, insolence and caricature.

name: BÖRÜ 2039
summary: Second series of the WOLF franchise starts 25 years after the first outing. As alliances wear thin, and notions of global order are shattered, the world of 2039 is on the brink of total war. Dangerous technologies that exceed the grasp of humanity's control threaten a frayed social fabric. The action-packed story will examine security and war in this near future world.

name: The '80s: Top Ten
summary: Pop culture icon Rob Lowe walks down memory lane with six top 10 countdowns of 1980s pop culture, as voted by a panel of experts.

name: Family Massacre
summary: A new series exploring gruesome tales of multiple murders within the same family.

name: The Boys Presents: Diabolical
summary: The Boys Presents: Diabolical reveals unseen stories within The Boys universe, brought to life by some of the most creative minds in entertainment today.

name: Teen Mom Family Reunion
summary: Cast members from across the Teen Mom franchise embark on a tropical vacation featuring unexpected guests, new friendships and deep dives into family and relationship drama.

name: Ghost Doctor
summary: Cha Young Min is a genius doctor, but he is arrogant and selfish. One day, he gets involved in an unexpected case. Due to the unexpected case, his spirit possesses another doctor's body. These two doctors are complete opposites, with opposite personalities and medical abilities.

name: Экипаж 314
summary: In a small town, where everyone knows each other, there are three employees of the patrol service, Valera, Sanych and Lyonya. Their attitude towards work cannot be called conscientious. Often, when faced with the criminal world, they have to act outside the box, sometimes even paradoxically and stupidly, breaking the law. Each appearance on duty is a separate dangerous adventure with a series of ridiculous situations, shootings, accidental killings and, of course, sparkling dialogues. Often they out of the blue create problems for themselves, from which they then have to extricate themselves.

name: Live: Winter on the Farm
summary: Helen Skelton and Jules Hudson follow life at Cannon Hall Farm with brothers Rob and Dave Nicholson, who are preparing their animals for a crucial season - one that can make or break their farm.

name: The Brigade: Race to the Hudson
summary: Ten participants from Canada and USA take the challenge to take the "Hudson Bay Route" from Castlegar (B.C.) to York Factory (Manitoba), through the Canadian wilderness, and on the rough.

name: The Asian Welsh
summary: Series exploring how immigration from the Indian subcontinent has transformed Welsh health, culture and the economy, and how Wales has changed those who have arrived over the past eight decades and made this place their home.

name: Tulsa King
summary: Tulsa King follows New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi, just after he is released from prison after 25 years and unceremoniously exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a "crew" from a group of unlikely characters, to help him establish a new criminal empire in a place that, to him, might as well be another planet.

name: The Sinking of the Costa Concordia
summary: The story of the disaster, which took place in January 2012 when the Italian cruise ship struck a rock, capsized and sank in shallow waters near Tuscany, resulting in 32 deaths.

name: Backwashed
summary: The postgrad bar on campus. Quiet, composed, dignified people preparing for the real world? No, it's more of a dumping ground for nearly-adults to ride out their university lives.

name: Walking Victorian Britain
summary: Historian Dr Onyeka Nubia examines the history of Victorian Britain by visiting various regions to better understand this period's complex history, which included societal changes, technological advancement, and injustice.

name: Forensics: Catching the Killer
summary: True crime series exploring horrific murders and the part forensic science played in finding the killers.

name: Nick Knowles Heritage Rescue
summary: Nick Knowles follows the restoration work of historical buildings in need of restoration, showing the results and diving into the history of the building.

name: One Night in...
summary: Alex Brooker and Josh Widdicombe spend the night at some of the UK's most exciting attractions with no other visitors around.

name: Annemizi Saklarken
summary: Handan who carried her first baby in her arms when she herself was still considered a child and has since given birth to two more, works as a private customer assistant in a well-known fashion workshop in Nişantaşı. Handan begins attending dress rehearsals at Zerrin and Dündar Demir's home ahead of their wedding anniversary and during this period, Handan and her children's life, which attracts the attention of Dündar, will change after Zerrin and Dündar's wedding anniversary party.

name: Sacha
summary: Anne Dupraz, a respected prosecutor in Geneva, is in custody for shooting a man, now between life and death. She admits her guilt but seems unable to explain her act. Her interrogation and that of her relatives will allow Anne to finally free herself from her past.

name: When Things Were Rotten
summary: Errol Flynn was probably spinning in his grave, but Mel Brooks's version of the antics of Robin Hood and his band of merry men is a laugh-getter. Though it's primarily a one-joke affair, Mel Brooks's brand of madness and a good cast, particularly Richard Dimitri playing the dual role of the foppish Bertram and a Chicago member of Robin's band called Renaldo, carry it off with all comedic stops pulled.

name: Alaskan Killer Bigfoot
summary: Seventy years ago, a murderous Bigfoot-like creature sent residents fleeing from Portlock, Alaska. Now, an expedition returns to the abandoned fishing village to determine if the terrifying beast locals call Nantinaq will allow it to be safely resettled.

name: Behind Cut
summary:
Ki Jin is a budding fashion design student who dreams big: He wants to become a world-famous clothing designer. But the journey to the top of South Korea's fashion tree is not an easy one, and he is struggling to find the right path. One day, on the street, he bumps into Young Woo, an ever-optimistic part-time delivery worker. Even though it seems everyone he knows has formulated a grand plan about how their future will unfurl, Young Woo doesn't have a dream. While all others are in a rush to get somewhere in life, it seems that his own life is stuck in first gear.

Although things have got off to a decidedly shaky start for Ki Jin and Young Woo, they start to develop a fondness for one another, and start to wonder if their seemingly opposing blend of determinedness and acceptance could be a case of "opposites attract." But when a leading model named Lee Bin arrives on the scene, things get complicated. He starts to develop a crush on Ki Jin. Could this development spell the end for the fledgling romance between Ki Jin and Young Woo?

name: Ben
summary: A recently divorced reporter moves back to her hometown of Nantes with her daughter, but painful memories await her there… When she was just 16, her Jehovah's Witness parents forced her to give up her newborn son, a decision that drove her to run away from home and leave Nantes.

name: Get Millie Black
summary: Get Millie Black follows ex-Scotland Yard detective Millie-Jean Black who returns home to Jamaica after her mother's passing and joins the Kingston police force. When a local girl disappears, Millie and her partner uncover ties to a prominent family — just as a Scotland Yard inspector arrives with his own agenda. Haunted by the ghosts of a sibling who refuses to be saved and a child who can't be found, Millie's search for the truth leads her on an intercontinental chase that threatens to blow up her world.

name: Love and Fortune
summary:
Love and Fortune is the story of Chok, a very unlucky young man where fate plays a prank and he had to be separated from his family at a young age. This made him decide to go out in search of his true birthplace. Fate, however, has led him to fall in love with Petchwasee, a noble woman with a good heart

How will the story of a love triangle, 1 woman, 2 men become a blood battle this time, and will the secret of the hidden birthplace be revealed?

name: I Literally Just Told You
summary:
I Literally Just Told You is the only game show in history where the contestants are given every answer with the questions written, literally, as the show is happening. You just need to pay attention to everything that's going on.

With each correct answer adding more cash to their prize pot, can the competitors keep their focus and remember the things they've seen and heard just minutes before?

In the dramatic finale, the remaining two contestants set each other questions. It's a chaotic battle of wits.

name: Gardeners' World Winter Specials
summary: Monty and the team celebrate the joy that the gardening year brings.

name: Britain's Favourite Toys
summary: A selection of the nation's best-loved toys and games, through the decades.

name: Capital Jingle Bell Ball
summary: Highlights of the pop concert held at London's O2.

name: Machines That Built the World
summary: The surprising stories and rivalries behind groundbreaking innovations and the larger-than-life characters who dreamt them up.

name: Thomas Cromwell: A Very Modern Tudor
summary: Tracy Borman investigates the rise of Thomas Cromwell from the son of a Putney blacksmith to Henry VIII's right hand man.

name: Jamie: Together at Christmas
summary: Jamie Oliver prepares festive treats the whole family can share.

name: SOKO Potsdam
summary: This SOKO is like the city of Potsdam itself - warm-hearted and honest. The friendship of the detectives shapes their investigations and sometimes makes things pop during the hunt for criminals.

name: SOKO Hamburg
summary: The Hamburg detectives investigate between modern city flair and down-to-earth country life. The exciting cases often take them across the Elbe to Schleswig-Holstein and Lower Saxony.

name: The Loner
summary: An offbeat black comedy trilogy about, in Les Dawson's own words, "a man coming from nowhere, going nowhere" and what happens to him in transit.

name: Chirp
summary: Chirp, Tweet and Squawk are three best friends who use their imaginations and everyday objects to get them into—and out of—fantastically fun adventures and hilariously sticky predicaments. Based on the best-selling and well-loved children's magazine Chirp, the CBC Kids' series celebrates play, imagination and the power of invention.

name: Государственная защита
summary:
Lieutenant Colonel Medvedev has been working in the police for the last few days. Firstly, the RUBOP, in which Nikolai gave twenty years of his life to serve, was decided to be disbanded, and secondly, Medvedev, succumbing to the insistence of his wife, was going to retire from the police force based on his years of service. On the eve of his dismissal, the operative has to participate in an operation to apprehend a dangerous criminal - a famous killer nicknamed Harness.
Realizing that this seasoned criminal will effortlessly bypass the ambush, Medvedev decides to detain him on his own, and he succeeds. This incident decisively changes his fate. Nikolai is summoned by his boss, General Kireev, and offers to head the new experimental department. Medvedev and his employees will have to protect witnesses whose lives and health are being threatened in connection with the investigation of certain criminal cases.

name: Alle mot Alle Julespesial
summary: Eight teams compete to create the best possible Christmas atmosphere, but what tasks are hidden behind the hatches in Alle mot Alles unique Christmas calendar?

name: History by the Numbers
summary: This series is loaded with mind-blowing factoids and stats, entertaining expert interviews, and infographics injected with cheeky humor.

name: Walker: Independence
summary: Abby Walker's husband is murdered before her eyes. On her quest for revenge, Abby crosses paths with Hoyt Rawlins. Abby and Hoyt's journey takes them to Independence, Texas, where they encounter residents running from their own pasts.

name: Forteresses assiégées, batailles de légende
summary:
Built at strategic points, and fitted with impressive fortifications and ingenious systems to counter attacks, fortresses are thought to be impenetrable. And yet, certain skillful warlords have successfully stormed them. How did they manage this?

By recounting how some of the most remarkable sieges - in ancient times or in medieval history - played out, this series revisits the construction of these megastructures and reveals the different strategies used to lay or to endure a siege. Thanks to CGI, dramatized scenes, and with the help of key experts, it immerses us in the compelling confrontation between the construction genius of the military strategists and the ingenuity of some exceptional warriors.

name: David & Annie: After the 90 Days
summary: David and Annie attempt to bring Annie's teen brother and cousin to the US.

name: Loren & Alexei: After the 90 Days
summary: Loren and Alexei get ready to take on life with two under 2!

name: Ein Hauch von Amerika
summary: In the early 1950's, the American military presence begins in a small West German region. In this context, the story of friendship is told by two young women who try to find their place in this time of upheaval. In doing so, they have to struggle again and again with the old order, the conservative forces from politics, church and society. Also playing an important role is the love story with a black soldier, who experiences freedom for the first time in Germany, but has to struggle with racist hostility.

name: Elinor Wonders Why
summary: This funny and engaging show follows a curious bunny named Elinor as she asks the questions in every child's mind and discovers the wonders of the world around her. Whether it's borrowing tricks from birds and fish to make a go-cart go faster, or imitating animal camouflage techniques to improve at hide-and-seek, Elinor and her friends Ari and Olive explore the wonderful and amazing ways nature connects to our everyday lives. Each episode encourages children to follow their curiosity about nature, to ask questions they don't understand and to find answers using basic science practices. This series is filled with curiosity, nature and wonder, while encouraging children and parents at home to ask their own questions and experience the joy of discovery and understanding.

name: NOOD
summary: Four 112 dispatchers are faced with the most extraordinary emergencies to deal with under great pressure. They attend to callers in telephone conversations that are far from mundane. Conversations that you hope you never have to have in your life, but which are the order of the day for the dispatchers. From the perspectives of the control room and the caller, decisions are made on the spot that can make the difference between life and death. Every conversation is a battle against time.

name: Corduroy
summary:
Corduroy is an animated children's television series based on Don Freeman's 1968 children's book Corduroy and its 1978 follow-up A Pocket for Corduroy. It originally aired for one season on TVOKids in Canada and PBS Kids' Bookworm Bunch in the US in 2000. After the final episode, reruns were aired until Oct. 28, 2001 (where it got cancelled along with Elliot Moose). The show consists of 26 10-minute stories, which were broadcast in pairs as 13 21-minute episodes.

The story is set in New York City and follows the teddy bear Corduroy and his best friend Lisa as they travel around their city.

name: Wimzie's House
summary: A five year old dragon bird hybrid spends time with her friends at her grandmother's daycare learning new things each day.

name: Alex vs America
summary:
Alex Guarnaschelli is one of the most accomplished and revered chefs in the culinary arena, having won virtually every battle she has ever competed in. Now, over the course of five weeks, 15 brave chefs from across the United States take their best shot at beating Alex for the ultimate culinary triumph in the new competition series, Alex vs America. Hosted by the acclaimed chef Eric Adjepong, each episode features three culinary superstars competing over two rounds against one another as well as against Alex. These competitors might hail from different states, but they all share the same mastery of a specific ingredient or dish, one that they have spent endless hours in their own kitchens perfecting and which will now be tested in an effort to take down one of the country's most formidable chefs.

At the start of each battle, Alex and the competitors learn what the challenge will be, with the chefs having the ability to work together in selecting variables for their dishes as well as the amount of time they give themselves and Alex to cook with. Each finished plate will undergo a blind tasting, with only the top three chefs advancing and the least successful from the challenge being immediately sent home, even if it is Alex. In the end, it all comes down to what's on the plate. Will the final two chefs outcook and outshine Alex, earning bragging rights over an award-winning Iron Chef? Or will Alex's legendary winning streak continue, sending all the ambitious competitors home with nothing but their disappointment?

name: Winning Time: The Rise of the Lakers Dynasty
summary: The drama series that goes back in time to chronicle the professional and personal lives of the 1980s Los Angeles Lakers, one of sports' most revered and dominant dynasties. The show takes a look at a team that defined its era, both on and off the court. Based on Jeff Pearlman's book, Showtime: Magic, Kareem, Riley, and the Los Angeles Lakers, and executive produced by Adam McKay

previousepisode.name: What Is and What Should Never Be

name: É O Amor: Família Camargo
summary: Surrounded by family and friends, Zezé Di Camargo and daughter Wanessa spend time together and collaborate creatively in this exclusive reality series.

name: Sainz: Live to Compete
summary: Carlos Sainz has turned 59 years old. While rivals of his generation have already hung up the helmet, he continues at the highest level, year after year. His story is an example of perseverance. Two-time world rally champion and three-time Dakar winner, his ambition knows no bounds. We live with him the most hectic year of his, which has also meant the debut of his son, Carlos, as a Ferrari driver.

name: Sky on Fire
summary: The drama centers around President Eva Ortiz, a decorated war veteran and the nation's first Latina president, who, after surviving an assassination attempt, embarks on an undercover mission to expose the people responsible.

name: Confessions of a Fashionista
summary: In contradiction to the perfection and glamour they portray on social media, two fashionistas live a harsh reality and suffer constant turmoil.

name: Tiger King: The Doc Antle Story
summary: This "Tiger King" docuseries details disturbing allegations of sexual abuse, violence and misconduct by big cat zoo owner Bhagavan "Doc" Antle.

name: Queer Eye Germany
summary: Five experts in lifestyle, fashion, beauty, health and design — known as the Fab Five — dazzle a nation and transform lives in this makeover series.

previousepisode.name: Möge die Macht mit Eugen sein

name: One Mo' Chance
summary: From the breakdown of his relationship with the mother of his children, to the death of his brother and partner Real," the last few years have been personally tough for Kamal Chance Givens. However, the original Stallionaire is now ready to get back on his horse to give love another shot. During Chance return to reality television we'll watch as he goes it alone to find the true love of his life in this new dating competition series.

name: I Am the Years You Are the Stars
summary: Jin Xiao Yu, a girl with a strange illness, meets the mysterious fashion designer Jiang Bai Jiu during a bus accident. In search of the truth behind the mystery, Xiao Yu and Bai Ju heal each other and fall in love.

name: Through the Darkness
summary: Through the Darkness is about a criminal profiler who struggles to read the minds of serial killers. Song Ha Young is a criminal profiler. He is calm and has charisma. He digs up cases and looks deeply into the human mind.

name: Her Bucket List
summary:
Chara is devastated when she finds out that the guy she loved so much has unexpectedly passed away. Not knowing how she can find the strength to continue living without him, Ra Ri decides to follow her boyfriend after death. The list of common desires that she wrote with him many years ago inspires her to refrain from death for a while longer. Ra Ri decides to fulfill all the items on this list. On her way, she meets Kang Han Sol, an idol trainee with great potential, but a strong stage fright. Brought together by fate, Ra Ri and Han Sol begin to fulfill the wishes from the list together, and the time spent together gives them the strength to hold out for some more time. Ra Ri and Han Sol begin to realize that unexpected feelings are growing between them and the pain they both experienced is slowly subsiding. Will these feelings give them the strength they need to continue living, no matter what?
Adapted from the webtoon of the same name.

name: Meeting You Loving You
summary: A love story full of pain and happiness with Jinyan and Song Qin Chun. The two overcome past grievances to be together again.

name: Женские мечты о дальних странах
summary: 1990s. A young financier is transporting his company's funds, but his girlfriend sets him up and robs him. On the run, he will spend many years trying to rise from the depths and find his betrayer.

name: Spare Me, Great Lord!
summary: This is the story of an orphan, Lu Shu. He is not any regular orphan, but a metahuman experiencing the changes in himself, his country and the world during the dawn of the magical era. Watch as Lu Shu embarks on a journey to hone his peculiar abilities together with his sister, the adorable and charismatic Lu Xiaoyu. Along the way, they'll encounter supernatural events, obstacles and even the most powerful people in their country. How will Lu Shu make the best of his abilities and oust his never-ending list of rivals and opponents?

name: Dream Garden
summary: When it comes to matters of the heart, Xiao Xiao considers himself an expert. Xiao Xiao is a blogger who deals with all kinds of relationship problems without lacking experience when it comes to love. However, all her experience on the Internet cannot prepare her for the first meeting with Lin Shen, a professional psychologist who sees the world in a completely different way. These two are invited to one reality show, but they can't find a common language. After the show, she hoped she would never have to deal with him again. But fate, as it turned out, had other plans. Hoping to improve his ability to analyze emotional problems by studying with a real professional, Xiao Xiao applies for the position of assistant professional psychologist. Too late, she realizes that the professional she works for is none other than the heartless Lin Shen. Despite the initial differences, they not only respect each other, but also understand that working together, they can help their clients overcome a number of serious problems. But will working together help them sort out their own complicated feelings?

name: BBS: The Documentary
summary: Long before the Internet escaped from the lab, connecting the planet and redefining what it meant to meant to be a computer user... ...there was a brave and pioneering band of hobbyists who spent their time, money and sanity setting up their home computers and phone lines to welcome anyone who called. By using a modem, anyone who knew the phone number of these machines could connect to them, leave messages, play games, send and receive files in a virtual community... and millions did. They called these places "Bulletin Board Systems", or BBSes. Their collections of messages, rants thoughts and dreams became the way that an entire generation learned about being online.

name: LOL: Se Rir, Já Era
summary: Prepare your jaws! Tom Cavalcante and Clarice Falcão bring together 10 comedians for a six-hour competition in which they can't laugh, but have to make others laugh.

previousepisode.name: O ovo, a passista e a preguiça

name: Там, где нас нет
summary: When Yulia's father starts having problems with his business, he moves the family from St. Petersburg to Vyborg. Yulia finds herself in a new school, but her classmates are hostile to her. She meets Tema and Fred, who turn out to be members of a strange online group. The group is led online by an unknown person, Gurd. They hold events designed to teach arrogant classmates a lesson. But the pranks of new friends soon cease to be innocent. Julia decides to leave the group, but it turns out that it is too late. It is no longer teenage schoolchildren who are being targeted, but their parents...

name: Breakfast with Eamonn & Isabel
summary: Wake up to Eamonn Holmes and Isabel Webster as they bring you the Great British Breakfast. It's your daily dose of news, politics, sport and entertainment. It's news with opinion.

name: Sammy & Co
summary: In an underwater village bordering a tropical island, two young turtles and their pals keep their home safe and enjoy adventures in the big, wild sea.

name: My Dress-Up Darling
summary: Traumatized by a childhood incident with a friend who took exception to his love of traditional dolls, doll-artisan hopeful Wakana Gojou passes his days as a loner, finding solace in the home ec room at his high school. To Wakana, people like beautiful Marin Kitagawa, a trendy girl who's always surrounded by a throng of friends, is practically an alien from another world. But when cheerful Marin—never one to be shy—spots Wakana sewing away one day after school, she barges in with the aim of roping her quiet classmate into her secret hobby: cosplay! Will Wakana's wounded heart be able to handle the invasion from this sexy alien?!

name: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt
summary: Prince Wein is ready to commit treason. And who can blame him? Faced with the impossible task of ruling his pathetic little kingdom, this poor guy just can't catch a break! But with his brilliant idea of auctioning off his country, this lazy prince should be able to retire once and for all. Or that was the plan...until his treasonous schemes lead to disastrous consequences-namely, accidental victories and the favor of his people!

previousepisode.name: The Prince Who Would Sell His Kingdom As Expected

name: Sabikui Bisco
summary:
A plague-like wind blows across the arid, sandy expanse of a post-apocalyptic Japan. As it sweeps over the living and nonliving alike, rust is all that remains in its wake. The cause of the catastrophic state of the world is believed to be mushroom spores. Bisco Akaboshi, known as the "Man-Eating Mushroom," is a wanted criminal archer whose arrows instantly grow mushrooms wherever they land. However, he is in truth a "Mushroom Protector," a person who spreads fungi in order to enrich the land and return it to its previous state.

Alongside the crab Akutagawa and young doctor Milo Nekoyanagi, Bisco ventures through the wastelands of Japan searching for the legendary "Sabikui"—a panacean mushroom said to devour all forms of rust.

name: Mahkum
summary: Convicted of murdering his wife and child, he wakes up one day with amnesia and doesn't know why he's in prison, a prosecutor seeking to regain his memory and clear his name.

name: Death and Other Details
summary: Set amidst the glamor of the global elite, Death and Other Details centers on the brilliant and restless Imogene Scott, who finds herself in the wrong place/wrong time (okay, it was kinda her fault) and becomes the prime suspect in a locked room murder mystery. The setting? A lavishly restored Mediterranean ocean liner. Suspects? Every pampered guest and every exhausted crew member. The problem? To prove her innocence, she must partner with a man she despises - Rufus Cotesworth, the world's greatest detective.

name: Сердце не обманет, сердце не предаст
The Now
summary: Ed Poole's life isn't going as he planned. However, a tragic event causes him to rethink his outlook, forcing him to go after what he loves, cherish the people closest to him and live in The Now.

name: Straight Sassy
summary: The mini-drama shows the realities of modern relationships. The story of a couple in love - a shy girl who has not yet learned to speak directly about her desires, and her young man, who, like many guys, does not understand hints. Ahead of the couple in love, there are many difficulties, ups and downs that will affect the modern realities of our life.

name: The Tammy Grimes Show
summary: This short lived show is about a rich heiress who wanted nothing more to do than spend money. But her Uncle Simon is keeping a tight hand on the wallet. Her twin brother Terrence and her housekeeper Mrs. Ratchett are also an irritation to Tammy.

name: The Iran-Iraq War
summary: This documentary series delves into the Iran–Iraq War led by Khomeini and Saddam Hussein, revisiting key moments and exploring the leaders' motives.

name: Lace
summary: Lacey is a prolific lawyer for the rich and powerful in Los Angeles who can make anyone's problems disappear--except her own, which often blurs the lines between right and wrong.

name: Veipatruljen
summary: In Veipatruljen you meet Oslo's tough car rescuers, who are always at work to help unlucky drivers and make a huge effort to clear the roads, and ensure accessibility for residents.

name: Tatovørene
summary: We meet the colorful artists who work at Attitude, one of Norway's busiest and most renowned tattoo studios.

name: Ole Martins kjøkken
summary: Ole Martin Alfsen shows you step by step how to easily make different dishes.

name: Norges Beste Brannmann
summary: Ten dedicated firefighters from all over the country will compete both individually and as a team, and they will face challenges that push them to the limit. After seven episodes, one fire constable will remain the winner, and can travel home to their fire station with a brand new emergency vehicle.

name: Hotelleventyret
summary: Join us when Petter Stordalen opens Norway's largest hotel, Clarion Hotel The Hub, right in the center of Oslo.

name: Juleølkalenderen
summary: We choose the ultimate Christmas drink! A panel consisting of Rikke Isaksen and Niklas Baarli, led by Fridtjof Nilsen, will taste a new drink every day until Christmas. The drink has of course been selected and served by real Norwegian celebrities.

name: Jegertvillingene
summary: In the series Jegertvillingene we follow Kristine and Johanne on their first trip out into the world to hunt and fish. In the TV series, we join them in new hunting grounds in the United States, from Florida's swamps to the Idaho wilderness. Here they meet like-minded hunters, new forms of hunting and animals they have never seen before.

name: Surfside Girls
summary: Sam and Jade are psyched to spend their summer riding the waves and catching the rays. That is until they meet a ghost. The girls dive head-first into a mystery about a pirate ship and the cursed treasure that allegedly lies beneath Surfside's beloved Danger Point bluff. After meeting a pirate ghost named Remi, Sam wants to help him break the curse while Jade is determined to find a scientific explanation for the existence of ghosts. To solve the mystery, Sam and Jade will need to combine their very different approaches of logic and imagination. Together, they are determined to connect the clues, solve the mystery and save Surfside... and maybe they'll help a couple of pirate ghosts along the way.

name: Chillin Island
summary: New York City natives and rap personalities Alec "Despot" Reinstein, Ashok "Dap" Kondabolu and Aleksey "Lakutis" Weintraub invite their friends to join them at the edge of nature. To commune in deserts and swamps in a valiant effort to reveal unknowable truths from the dreamstate of the shared human existence.

name: Drenge
summary: Every Sunday morning, 10 young men in Silkeborg gather to sing in a church choir. Over the years, the group have formed a close bond, and after the bells fall silent, they meet to push their limits and test the forbidden pleasures of adult life. But when one of the boys drowns under mysterious circumstances, their unity and loyalty are put to the ultimate test.

name: Sexpertene
summary: Mutasim "Mutta" Billah visits twelve high schools. In each place, three students will learn all about one sex topic and become the school's own "sex experts".

name: Grenseløst forelsket
summary: We follow Norwegians who have found love across national borders. What is it like to be head over heels in love with someone who lives in and comes from a different country and a completely different culture?

name: Linnis univers
summary: Who is Linni Meister behind the flashlights - and what is she really living off? Now Linni opens the doors to her busy everyday life.

name: Den store matfesten – Toscana
summary: Ronny Brede Aase and Lise Finckenhagen bring ten celebrities to Tuscany.

name: Alt du elsker
summary: Sara discovers that Jonas is carrying a dark secret. How far is Jonas willing to go to gain recognition in the right-wing extremist forums he frequents? And is it possible for Sara to still see the person behind all the thoughts she cannot understand or accept?

name: UT
summary: Parts of Norway's gay history are seen through the eyes and hearts of more than 50 famous Norwegians.

name: Politiet - Tango 38
summary: We follow the Oslo Police District's 'Section for Traffic and Maritime Services' on assignments in and around the capital. The police car Tango 38 is almost always out in the busy streets of Oslo to ensure the safety of the population and to fight crime.

name: Redningshundene
summary: They have a single goal: to find the missing person. Regardless. When the police sound the alarm, the volunteers and their rescue dogs rush out to search.

name: Den beste Funkytwin
summary: We follow Emil and Silas through various challenges to find out once and for all which of them is the best Funkytwin.

name: 5 i uka
summary: Months of dating are compressed down to one week, when five hopeful suitors move in with their fiancées, to compete to be the one left when the week is over. Along the way, they have to compete in competitions, quizzes and activities. They must also try to impress both the group of friends and their possible future in-laws!

name: Katastrofen Kielland
summary: 123 people died when the housing platform Alexander L. Kielland walked around the North Sea in 1980. Survivors and those left behind still have many questions. What really happened?

name: Love of Kill
summary: She's a professional hitman. And he…is also a professional hitman. And she's his target. Caught in a deadly game of cat- and-mouse, will she fall first…or will he?

name: BTK: Confession of a Serial Killer
summary:
Dennis Lynn Rader, also known as "BTK," an acronym he gave himself standing for "Blind, Torture, Kill," is one of the most infamous killers in recent American history. BTK: Confession of a Serial Killer, a two-part documentary event, examines the horrific crimes and psyche of the notorious serial killer and provides unprecedented access into the mind of Rader, who is currently serving 10 consecutive life sentences in El Dorado Correctional Facility.

"BTK: Confession of a Serial Killer" sheds new light on Rader's double life as both an upstanding citizen and a heartless killer, showcasing the intimate details of Rader's past and his gruesome murders while providing insight on how to better identify and potentially deter extreme violent offenders in the future.

name: Love at the End of the World
summary: An erotic suspense BL series exploring the lives of four couples as they navigate through love, pain, loss, romance, forgiveness, redemption, loneliness and sorrow. After reports from NASA confirm that an asteroid is set to hit Earth in 7 days resulting in global catastrophe, priorities quickly change and panic ensues.

name: Asia Artist Awards
summary: Asia Artist Awards (abbreviated AAA) is an awards ceremony organized by South Korea-based business newspaper Money Today and its global media brands StarNews and MTN. It honors outstanding achievements and international contributions of Asian artists in television, film and music.

name: Fantasy Bishoujo Juniku Ojisan to
summary: A dull old man and his handsome best friend were summoned to another world by a naked goddess! However, because of the goddess's mischief, he has turned into a peerless beautiful girl?! To get back his body, he has to go on a journey with his best friend to defeat the demon king!! "An old man that became a beautiful girl" and "A handsome old man"! Let the madness-filled, rom-com journey in another world begin!!

previousepisode.name: A Guy Who Reincarnated as a Fantasy Knockout and

name: Tribe Nine
summary:
Haru Shirogane is a weak-minded person who is constantly bullied while Taiga has traveled from across the sea in hopes of becoming the strongest man in the world. One night, the two meet up with Shun Kamiya, the strongest XB (Extreme Baseball) player, and leader of the Minato Tribe. When they meet, each of the Tribes scattered throughout Neo-Tokyo are about to face a major threat.
